finalText:
**Drafted 4.2.0 in [CHANGELOG.md:3](CHANGELOG.md:3).** 380 commits, 12 worth telling users.

Three breaks. Expired tokens now return `401`, not `403`. Error types are no longer re-exported from `auth`, `billing`, `core`, `db`, `jobs`. The v1 export route is gone.

One feature. Webhook deliveries retry with backoff.

Eight fixes. Null cursor crash, empty allowlist, double trailing slash, duplicate header, dropped trace id, request body in logs, wrong histogram units, HTTP timer and pool leaks.

I left out perf work. No numbers to quote.

Next: check if the minimum Node version rose. Three commits hint at it and I cannot see `.nvmrc` here.
